name: Tattoo & Piercing

emergency: swelling or heat after a tattoo

extra_prompt: You are booking for a tattoo or piercing studio. Ask about the design idea, size, placement, and any reference images. Ask about skin conditions, allergies, and medications. Ask whether they want a consultation or are ready to book. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed after consultation and design. Do not give medical advice. Advise that clients must be 18+ for tattoos (unless local law allows otherwise with consent).

kb.q: How much does a tattoo cost?
kb.a: {price_note} Tattoos are priced by size, detail and time, and we give you a quote after your consultation.
Yes, custom work needs a consultation to talk through design, size and placement. We also discuss aftercare before you book.
Yes, we do cover-ups after a consultation. Cover-up pricing starts from the rate on your quote, and the final cost depends on the design.

kb.q: Do you do fine line work?
kb.a: Yes, we do fine line and micro tattoos. We talk through size and placement with you first, because fine detail needs the right design.
Yes, we do realism and portrait work. These take longer, so we confirm session length and price at your consultation.
Yes, we do colour and black and grey work. Tell us the style you like, and we will match you with an artist who works in it.
Eat, drink water and sleep well before your session. Avoid alcohol for 24 hours before, and tell us about any medical conditions or medications.
Yes, we do ear, nose, lip and body piercings. Please tell us about any allergies, especially to metals, before you book.

kb.q: Can I bring my own jewellery?
kb.a: Only if it is implant-grade and sterile. We supply safe jewellery and can advise on the right size.
We offer tattoo removal or refer you to a specialist. Removal takes more than one session, and each session is priced as listed on your quote.
Yes, you must be 18 or over for tattoos and most piercings. We require photo ID when you book.
{deposit_note} Deposits are taken to secure your booking.
Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may forfeit your deposit. Please call or message us as soon as you know you cannot make it.
Yes, touch-ups are included within {touchup_window} on our work. Please book them once the skin has healed.

kb.q: How do I care for my tattoo?
kb.a: We give you aftercare instructions and aftercare product at the end of your session. Follow the steps closely to help it heal well.

kb.q: Do you have a minimum charge?
kb.a: {minimum_note} Small tattoos start from the rate on your quote.

compliance.guidance: Tattoo and skin penetration businesses need registration with the state health department (in Victoria, the Department of Health). Keep hygiene and sterilisation records and client consent forms. Check your state rules.
